checkedAlternates.risk: Eris is one of the five IAU-recognized dwarf planets alongside Pluto, Makemake, and Haumea.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Eris has a high-eccentricity inclined orbit in the Scattered Disc (group-2), outside the classical Kuiper Belt (group-4).

checkedAlternates.risk: Ceres is an IAU dwarf planet.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Ceres orbits in the inner Main Asteroid Belt between Mars and Jupiter (group-1), not beyond Neptune.
